# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User prefers that when code is provided, the file name should be shown above the code, especially for frontend code sections.
- Always explicitly include the filename when giving code instructions or identifying code locations.
- User views `main.jsx` as being under a `src` folder in Solution Explorer.
- Always include a target file path in every Markdown code block when providing code changes.
- User wants explicit file names when suggesting fixes.
- User prefers deterministic frontend URL behavior and clear, consistent instructions tied to exact filenames and ports.

## PDF Ingestion Settings
- Disable startup/background PDF ingestion; embeddings should be processed only on explicit user uploads from the UI.

## URL Formatting
- User prefers URLs without leading bullet points/dots; provide plain URLs or code-block URLs instead of list items.
